title: PART 3 / THE SHOWDOWN
goal: Put learning into action through a shared challenge that develops communication, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
outcomes: Contribute ideas and agree on a shared team plan.

focus: Notice how students share ideas and make one meaningful decision together.

migration_review.timing: 2026-11-03 human decisions: challenge times: Design 20–30, Decorate 35–40, Bake 30–35, Mystery 35–45 min; intro 10 and clean-up/TASTE 20–25 (realistic Grade 4–6 estimates, human decision 2026-11-04); Bake and Mystery pans go in by a fixed cutoff and bake during step 3. The Showdown overview (Preparation) holds each option's restrictions and prep for choosing; each option's activity guide holds its planning, roles and tips. This guide links the overview and activity guides once, in Preparation, and keeps only the flow and cards. TASTE Reflection (2026-11-03): handed out at Tune-In, then a fixed 10–15 min guided walk-through after clean-up; early finishers clean their station, then start their sheet. Team sizes (2026-11-03 human decision): Design and Decorate 2–3, Bake and Mystery 3–5 depending on oven space; group_size gives the Print Pack Builder's default (3 and 4). Revised 2026-11-04 (human decisions): Preparation links only the overview and print pack; each activity guide is linked at its option on a DO row (human decision 2026-11-04); clean-up is the last step of each activity guide (Design 5, Decorate, Bake and Mystery 10 min) and is included in each option's time; step 3 is the shared TASTE walk-through (10–15 min), continued next class in a short period; lesson 45–80 min, so Design fits one 45-min period. Revised 2026-11-04 (human decisions): single best-estimate times; intro 5, TASTE 10; Design 25, Decorate 30 (fits one 45-min period), Bake and Mystery 45 each; lesson 40–60 min.
